title: Fallout 3 Janus Bear Teddy/Gnome/Skeleton Spatial Enrichment Technical Gate

inputs.optional_exact_context_map: JSON object mapping exact ESM location_key -> TRAGEDY|CHILD_ROOM|STORE|ORDINARY_DOMESTIC|INDUSTRIAL|OTHER

method: export every official placed REFR, not only targets, preserving exact base record and XYZ
classify target teddy/skeleton/gnome base IDs exactly; all remaining REFRs become OTHER
require exact same location_key before any distance pairing
compute nearest teddy->skeleton, teddy->gnome, gnome->skeleton and gnome->teddy distances
primary enrichment control is other MISC REFR clutter in the same locations that contain teddies
secondary broad control is all non-target REFRs in those same locations
compute observed 128/512 teddy-near-skeleton rates, matched-control rates, risk ratio, odds ratio and two-sided Fisher exact p
emit per-location counts so one dense cell cannot hide the distribution
context-specific CHILD_ROOM/STORE/etc comparisons are accepted only from an external exact location-key ledger; no automatic cell-name heuristic becomes evidence
primary_question: Are teddy bears statistically enriched within 128 or 512 game units of skeleton remains relative to comparable ordinary MISC clutter in the same cells/locations?
secondary_questions: How often are teddy bears within 128/512 units of garden gnomes?
How often are gnomes within 128/512 units of skeletons?
How many teddy scenes form a teddy+gnome+skeleton triad within 512 units?
Do exact context-ledger categories show different teddy density or tragedy-proximity rates?

admission_semantics.spatial_enrichment: May establish a repeatable placement grammar if effect is substantial and survives exact master replay.
admission_semantics.authorial_intent: Cannot be proved by enrichment alone; manual scene/design evidence remains separate.
admission_semantics.single_in_world_placer: Cannot be inferred from any enrichment ratio.
admission_semantics.child_ownership: Cannot be inferred from proximity alone.
admission_semantics.gnome_sentience: Cannot be inferred from posed scenes or proximity.

cases: strong teddy/skeleton enrichment produces expected 20x risk ratio and Fisher p < 0.01
non-MISC broad controls do not contaminate the primary MISC clutter baseline
different location keys never pair even with matching coordinates
damaged gnome is tracked and teddy+gnome+skeleton triad is counted
zero control-hit baseline returns explicit infinite risk ratio rather than crashing
exact context map separates TRAGEDY and STORE rates without name heuristics
no statistical result derives authorial intent, single secret placer or living gnome

next_gate.name: JANUS_BEAR_REAL_ESM_SPATIAL_ENRICHMENT_RECEIPT
success_condition: freeze exact population counts and 128/512 rates
bind manually reviewed exact context ledger for child rooms, stores and ordinary clutter
repeat analysis after excluding overt joke/diorama scenes to test robustness
